name: Calendly
description: Review Calendly event types and availability, and use supported scheduling actions.

methods.label: Sign in with Calendly
methods.whenToUse: Connect the provider-hosted Calendly MCP server with browser sign-in.
methods.guidanceMd: Check the connected account, event type, timezone, availability, and attendee details before using a scheduling write. Use a test scheduling artifact only when the discovered tool explicitly supports it.
warnings: Calendly MCP requires DCR and OAuth 2.1 authorization-code with PKCE S256. It does not support personal access tokens or manually provisioned static OAuth clients.
The provider advertises both scheduling read and write scopes for full access; verify the live tool catalog before enabling booking or link creation.
